searchText: just as a clarification https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/101 execution requests will "never" return as null but an empty object from the builder if there are no requests at the moment right? trying to interpret validation on implementation one is to accept the nil/nulls loosely and replace with your own empty object vs throwing an error if the bid returns with nil or null on execution requests that's how it should be interpreted right? we throw an error if `execution_requests` field is missing post-electra, we did the same for `blob_kzg_commitments` after deneb great i thought that's the right way to interpret it too also in case of ssz this would fail deserialization if the field is omitted

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content:
just as a clarification https://github.com/ethereum/builder-specs/pull/101
execution requests will "never" return as null but an empty object from the builder if there are no requests at the moment right? trying to interpret validation on implementation
one is to accept the nil/nulls loosely and replace with your own empty object vs throwing an error if the bid returns with nil or null on execution requests

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: that's how it should be interpreted right?

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: we throw an error if `execution_requests` field is missing post-electra, we did the same for `blob_kzg_commitments` after deneb

excerpts.author: jameshe5018
excerpts.content: great i thought that's the right way to interpret it too

excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content: also in case of ssz this would fail deserialization if the field is omitted
